sentences.text: The documents define EMI as an equated monthly instalment toward principal and interest, but they do not provide a calculable EMI for a loan of ₹40,00,000 at 9.75% per annum over 78 months.
The only EMI amount shown in the in-force loan documents is ₹21,696, and it is tied to a sanctioned loan amount of ₹25,00,000, an interest rate of 8.5% p.a., and a loan term of 240 months.
